newsitem.title: USA: Inland Resources sells preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Inland Resources sells preferred stock.

text.p: Inland Resources Inc said Monday that an affiliate of Enron Corp has purchased 100,000 shares of a newly designated Series C Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock for $10 million.
The Series C Stock accrues a 10 percent annual dividend, compounded quarterly, but payable only upon redemption of the Series C Stock or Inland's dissolution and liquidation.
Each share is initially convertible into Inland common stock at a conversion price of $12.00 per share.
Inland traded at 10 on the Nasdaq in the morning.
